preflight.idea: A seed bank with six separable futures

zones.assembly: Blunt tapered vessel with a stepped sealed roof, restrained lime band and four recessed aft bells.
zones.bill: Welded gray-green alloy skin, dark replaceable roof courses and lime identity paint; hard pressure seams and actual restrained radiused edges.

zones.assembly: Six oval sealed vaults, each with a shallow dark green glazed recess, structural rib course and raised end collars.
zones.bill: Tinted laminated conservatory glazing over opaque dark foliage silhouettes, seated warm cultivation light strips and pale green alloy frame. No transparent interior jungle or glowing jelly.

zones.assembly: Two broad dark struts per pod support two visible keyed break collars and a nested release root.
zones.bill: Load-bearing alloy box spars and pale machined collars. Each released pod loses exactly its source assembly and native collider; empty slots remain empty.

preflight.review: Open actual Look top/chase/close, repair seen defects, then publish.
